correctness.rationale: A complete coordinate-resource bijection determines every coefficient with exact factorial symmetry, and an integer interval proves the maximum. The general vertex-edge-cover lower bound follows from induced subgraph components, and the two-row equality cases are fully classified, including width 2 and 3 exceptions. Two independently constructed finite checkers verify the formula and cover census; finite checks corroborate but do not substitute for the infinite proof.
